hypothesis_contract.null: Requiring two consecutive completed decision events with the same eligible V30 USD consensus does not produce positive RAW walk-forward equity or does not make both full comparable months reach 2.0x under both normal and adverse costs.
hypothesis_contract.alternative: A two-event persistence confirmation removes transient V30 releases while preserving its scope and direction formula, improving RAW edge enough for both full comparable months to reach 2.0x under normal and adverse costs.

training_only_persistence_selection.selection_basis: Two is the minimum nontrivial persistence rule: one reproduces V30 and any larger count adds an extra arbitrary delay. Selection used completed signal timestamps, directions and predecision inventory structure only.

persistence_confirmation_rule.name: TWO_CONSECUTIVE_COMPLETED_DECISION_EVENTS_SAME_USD_CONSENSUS
persistence_confirmation_rule.confirmation_unit: one completed global V25 decision timestamp
persistence_confirmation_rule.first_confirmation: When the unchanged V30 release inequality is true, record the consensus USD sign and decision ordinal but do not release at that event.
persistence_confirmation_rule.release_formula: Release at decision event k only if event k-1 armed the same consensus_usd_direction and the unchanged V30 scope, minimum-peer, unanimity and opposite-inventory inequality are true again at k.
persistence_confirmation_rule.no_retroactivity: Information at event k may release only at event k's executable open and never alters the action at event k-1.
persistence_confirmation_rule.base_quote_to_usd_sign: For USD_QUOTE pairs, usd_sign(direction)=-direction. For USD_BASE pairs, usd_sign(direction)=direction.
persistence_confirmation_rule.tie_missing_gap_or_peer_shortage: Clear pending confirmation and preserve inventory; a later eligible event begins a new two-event sequence.
persistence_confirmation_rule.own_pair_signal: Clear pending confirmation; unchanged V30 same-direction hold or opposite-direction reverse applies.
persistence_confirmation_rule.finite_max_age_precedence: At every completed executable bar, max-age close occurs before persistence evaluation and clears pending confirmation.
persistence_confirmation_rule.weekend_gap: No synthetic bar or confirmation is inserted. The next actual completed decision event can confirm only if max-age has not already closed the sleeve; a missing target completed bar clears pending state.
persistence_confirmation_rule.terminal_liquidation: Close every remaining sleeve at the last completed bar close of each evaluation period and realize terminal MTM.

cost_arm_contract.raw_price: mid open/close with no spread, slippage, commission, or financing
cost_arm_contract.base_price: frozen V7 executable BID/ASK, slippage, commission, financing, and frozen decision-to-fill chronology
cost_arm_contract.adverse_price: frozen V7 adverse BID/ASK, slippage, commission, financing, and frozen decision-to-fill chronology

rejection_contract.system_fail: Any frozen hash, RAW identity, chronology, arm-transition parity, source, cap, max-age, terminal liquidation, MTM, authority, holdout, period, leverage, threshold, one-variable, or successor-routing-policy mismatch fails closed.
rejection_contract.profit_reject: Automatically reject if either full comparable month is below 2.0x in EXECUTABLE_BASE or ADVERSE_STRESS, or unopened holdout reproduction is absent.
rejection_contract.raw_edge_reason: CONSENSUS_RELEASE_PERSISTENCE_RAW_EDGE_ABSENT when walk-forward RAW equity is at or below 1.0.
